hooks.base_rate: historical bucket frequencies from the history store, graded alongside; persistence forecaster graded alongside
buckets: spread widens bullish (more than plus 2 points)
spread within plus or minus 2 points
spread narrows or falls (more than minus 2 points)
hooks.cadence: weekly, Thursday after the AAII print is stored
hooks.grading: Brier score on the three buckets against base-rate and persistence baselines
hooks.horizon: one week, to the next AAII print
hooks.kill_condition: if the trailing-return model loses to a releases-only comparison model on pre-registered error over 36 consecutive live months at the monthly Michigan leg of P1, or loses to persistence on Brier over the first 52 weekly AAII forecasts, F1 is retired and survey forecasting reverts to measurement only
hooks.status_day_one: registered, not fired on 2026-10-30: the AAII source file was refused by the publisher route (HTTP 404 on the spreadsheet routes from this network) so there is no current print to forecast from. No substitute source was used.
hooks.variable: AAII bull minus bear spread, next weekly print

hooks.base_rate: historical frequency of above-median realised volatility windows from the history store, about 50 percent by construction
hooks.cadence: event-triggered, checked daily after the close; trigger is the G5 equity put/call ratio above its trailing 3 year 95th percentile
hooks.grading: Brier score against the base rate; the 20 day index return is recorded for information only and never scored as a forecast
hooks.horizon: 20 trading days from the session after the trigger
hooks.kill_condition: if directional content survives the trailing-return control with a stable sign across both the pre-2020 and post-2022 regimes in the backtest record, or across 30 live triggers, F2 is replaced by the directional version that earned it, through a design amendment, never by editing F2 in place
hooks.status_day_one: registered and trigger checked on 2026-10-30: not triggered (the put/call leg is absent at build, so the trigger cannot evaluate; named, not faked)
hooks.variable: probability that SPX realised volatility over the next 20 trading days exceeds its unconditional median for 20 day windows

hooks.base_rate: the best single family gauge alone, graded alongside as the named competitor
hooks.cadence: monthly, first session after the Baker and Wurgler value used is published and stored
hooks.grading: conditional spread against zero and against the best single component; any display on fewer than ten independent episodes is labelled preliminary
hooks.kill_condition: if the coincidence rule fails to beat its best component on the pre-registered metric in the backtest record, F3 never enters the live ledger at all; live, the hook is retired if the sign reverses over the first six independent live episodes
hooks.segment: months where at least two of four registered families sit in their high-sentiment extreme
hooks.status_day_one: NOT SHIPPED LIVE: the P22 backtest gate was not run in the v1 build (blocker recorded in history/backtests/BACKTEST-RECORD.md). Per design, the engine ships its family gauges with no composite forecast claim from this hook.
hooks.variable: 6 month spread, high sentiment beta basket minus low sentiment beta basket (Ken French characteristic sorts)

hooks.base_rate: printed inside the forecast itself, from the BACKTEST-RECORD (P19 historical board)
hooks.cadence: event-triggered, checked daily after the close
hooks.fixed_plain_language: capitulation signature seen. History says the low is a zone measured in weeks and percent, not this date.
hooks.grading: Brier score against the printed base rate, plus the path record (days to the eventual low, depth below the signature close) published at grading
hooks.kill_condition: if first signatures mark final lows within 5 percent in more than 70 percent of graded episodes across backtest and live boards combined, the engine may, with the record shown, upgrade capitulation to a timing input, through a design amendment; until then any wording treating a capitulation signature as a bottom call is a defect
hooks.segment: joint capitulation signature sessions on the G6 store (top decile volume, top decile VIX, bottom decile down breadth, same session or within three sessions)
hooks.status_day_one: registered and checked on 2026-10-30: no signature on day one (reduced-form check on the VIX leg printed in the BACKTEST-RECORD)
hooks.variable: probability that the index trades at least 5 percent below the first capitulation signature close within the following 60 sessions

ledger: ~/workspace/terminal-lineup/forecast/ledger.jsonl (estate append path only; this program contains no code path that opens the ledger file for writing directly)
